mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 110.0, indicating robust supply chain activity, corporate margins expand and earnings growth accelerates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 110.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past 6 months signals strong household demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening by the Fed, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and UNRATE decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the Fed's policy rate hikes reduce liquidity and increase discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.
